header.title: NNTP servers and fallback
header.description: The first server in the chain is used first. Missing or damaged segments fall over to the next active server; passwords are stored encrypted in the local vault only.

form.name: Primary provider
form.connections_hint: Maximum connections of this NNTP provider across all requests; one file uses all of them unless the general settings cap it
form.password_copy: The copy of {name} has no password: enter it again, the server takes the username only together with it.

chain.title: Server chain
chain.description: Servers are tried from top to bottom. Use the arrows to change the fallback order.
chain.move_up: Move up in the fallback order
chain.move_down: Move down in the fallback order

delete.title: Delete Usenet server
delete.description: The NNTP server “{name}” and its encrypted password will be deleted permanently.

indexers.description: A Newznab indexer, defined once: the LinkGrabber searches it, and an indexer subscription can take it over. The API key goes into the vault and is never shown again.
indexers.name: Name
indexers.url_hint: The API base address, e.g. https://api.omgwtfnzbs.org/api – an NZBHydra or Prowlarr on your own network works too
indexers.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored key
indexers.categories_hint: The categories a search asks for when it names none itself
indexers.list_description: The LinkGrabber searches the enabled indexers; a disabled one stays available to subscriptions.
indexers.empty: No indexer yet. With one, the LinkGrabber shows the indexer search.

delete.title: Delete the indexer?
delete.description: {name} and its stored API key are removed. Subscriptions that took it over keep their own copy.
